title: New law: A bill to provide that the chairmanship of the Commission on Security and Cooperation in Europe shall rotate between members appointed from the House of Representatives and Members appointed from the Senate, and for other purposes. (Public Law 99-7)
summary: S. 592 of the 99th Congress became Public Law 99-7 on 1985-03-27.

title: New law: A bill to apportion one-half of the funds for construction of the National System of Interstate and Defense Highways for fiscal years 1985 and 1986 and substitute highway and transit projects for fiscal years 1984 and 1985. (Public Law 99-4)
summary: H.R. 1251 of the 99th Congress became Public Law 99-4 on 1985-03-13.

title: New law: Pacific Salmon Treaty Act of 1985 (Public Law 99-5)
summary: H.R. 1093 of the 99th Congress became Public Law 99-5 on 1985-03-15.

title: New law: A joint resolution designating the week beginning March 3, 1985, as "Women's History Week". (Public Law 99-3)
summary: H.J.Res. 50 of the 99th Congress became Public Law 99-3 on 1985-03-08.

title: New law: A joint resolution to designate the week of March 24, 1985, through March 30, 1985, as "National Skin Cancer Prevention and Detection Week". (Public Law 99-6)
summary: H.J.Res. 85 of the 99th Congress became Public Law 99-6 on 1985-03-22.
